name: Header / Navigation
complexityReason: Off-canvas / multi-level navigation with active-state tracking, integrated search toggle, and responsive desktop-bar vs mobile-drawer. Usually a shared Experience Fragment.
functional: Logo links to the homepage.
Primary navigation exposes top-level categories; sub-navigation reveals child links.
Active category is highlighted.
Search entry point toggles the search field.
Responsive: persistent bar on desktop, drawer/hamburger on mobile.
acceptance: Navigation renders the full category tree on every page.
Selecting a top-level category reveals or navigates to its children.
The category matching the current page is marked active.
On mobile the menu button opens/closes the drawer.
verify: Click the menu/hamburger button; confirm drawer opens.
Click a top-level item; confirm sub-items reveal or navigation occurs.
Confirm active-state highlight on the current section.

name: Footer
complexityReason: Large multi-column link structure + social + legal + disclaimer, content-driven; usually a shared Experience Fragment.
functional: Logo linking home.
Social profile links (external).
Category link columns mirroring nav.
Legal/privacy links.
Disclaimer + copyright.
acceptance: Footer renders columns, social, legal and copyright on every page.
Social icons open the correct external profiles.
verify: Confirm footer is present on multiple templates and links resolve.

name: Callout (results band)
complexityReason: Promotional callout band with heading, stat/claim and CTA link(s); a background variation exists.
functional: Heading + claim/stat copy + CTA link(s).
Background variation for emphasis.
acceptance: Renders heading and CTA(s); CTAs navigate correctly.
Background variation renders with its themed background.
verify: Confirm CTA links; note background variation.

name: Carousel
complexityReason: Large multi-panel slider of audience/feature stories with imagery, headings, copy and many CTAs; prev/next navigation.

name: Article Card
complexityReason: Core reusable listing unit with multiple visual variations; drives listings, related content and carousels.
functional: Card is clickable to its target.
Shows image, category eyebrow, title, meta (read-time/byline/date) per variation.
Video variation overlays play icon + duration.
acceptance: Each card navigates to its target when clicked.
Category eyebrow links to the category.
Cards reflow responsively.
verify: Confirm card click navigates; check variation classes (small/medium/hero/video).

name: Hero
complexityReason: Static section hero (heading + copy + imagery) introducing the About page.

name: Testimonial
complexityReason: Quote/testimonial with attribution; may rotate multiple quotes.
functional: Displays a quote with attribution (name/role).
May cycle through multiple testimonials.
acceptance: Renders the quote and attribution.
If rotating, quotes cycle.
verify: Observe whether testimonials rotate or are static.

name: Case Study Article
complexityReason: Case-study detail body: eyebrow + H2 + narrative copy + imagery.
functional: Eyebrow + heading + long-form case-study narrative with imagery.
acceptance: Renders the case-study heading and body content.

name: Social Media Links
complexityReason: Static row of social icon links (usually in the footer XF).
functional: Row of social icon links opening brand profiles.
acceptance: Each social icon links to the correct external profile.

name: Related Reads
complexityReason: Related-content promo at the foot of a case study/insight linking to another read.
functional: Heading + related article promo (image + title) linking to another read.
acceptance: Renders the related item and links to it.

name: Feature columns
complexityReason: Alternating media + text blocks; observed as a horizontal scroller/slider of feature panels.

name: Flip Circles (interactive audience)
complexityReason: Interactive flip-card circles revealing audience segments on hover/click; requires flip interaction + responsive behavior.
functional: Grid of circular cards representing audience segments.
Hovering/clicking a circle flips it to reveal detail.
acceptance: Circles render in a grid.
Hover/click flips a circle to show its back content.
Works on touch (tap) as well as hover.
verify: Hover and click a circle; confirm the flip reveals back content on desktop and touch.

name: Feature Text (reveal)
complexityReason: Large statement text with a 'reveal' animation variation and an optional CTA.
functional: Prominent statement/heading with a scroll-triggered reveal animation.
Optional CTA button.
acceptance: Text renders and the reveal animation triggers on scroll.
CTA (if present) navigates correctly.
verify: Scroll to trigger the reveal; confirm animation and CTA.

name: Featured Persona
complexityReason: Rich persona narrative (e.g. 'Meet Maria') with many images and stacked sub-sections telling a customer story.
functional: Narrative persona feature: heading + sequential sub-sections with imagery describing a customer profile.
acceptance: Renders the persona narrative sections and imagery in order.
verify: Confirm the persona sections render (check for scroll animation).

name: Insights Filter + Search
complexityReason: Filterable/searchable insights list: type/topic filters, text search, apply/clear controls, results grid — client-side filtering (or query endpoint) with multiple states.
functional: Filter controls (Types, Topics, etc.) + a text search field.
Apply filters / Clear all controls.
Results grid updates to match filters/search.
Result cards link to insight articles.
acceptance: Selecting filters and applying narrows the results.
Text search narrows results.
Clear all resets filters and restores the full list.
Each result links to its insight.
verify: Apply a filter and confirm the results narrow.
Type a query and confirm results update.
Click Clear all and confirm reset.
Determine whether filtering is client-side or hits an endpoint.
